body_frame_conversion: Point-LIO IMU pose composed with measured sensor_from_base from lidar3d_robot_viz.yaml; Leg-KILO already outputs body pose. Calibration approximate, originally measured for visualization.
limitations: User confirmed stopping approximately near the start, not at a marked identical position. Endpoint distance is not measured return error.
Pose-to-pose steps include real motion and estimator noise, not pure jitter.
Factory odometry is a comparison estimate, not ground truth.
Leg-KILO original run was live on Jetson; other runs were replayed on laptop, candidate configs at 2x. No repeated controlled accuracy trial.
No loop closure accepted; loop_min_id_separation=50 is larger than this short run submap count.
configuration_decision: Promote kin_meas_noise=0.05 to experimental Leg-KILO config: smaller adjacent pose steps and floor tilt on walking replay, plus smaller maximum displacement on separate standing recording. Keep NDT enabled. Requires next live walking validation; no absolute accuracy claim.

held_out_standing.compute: laptop replay at 2x; baseline live on Jetson
